timer:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for the male character Kang Chuheun in reference image 1. Preserve exact black short hair, black martial uniform blue trim white collar gray sash, proportions, detailed pixel style, and SAME broad silver conical chain spear design. Transparent background. Layout exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, equal cells, no labels no grid no shadows, ample transparent margins every cell. Body consistently centered same scale, full body and weapon contained. Facing right.
Frames row1: 4 successive jump poses crouch compressed, pushing off toes, legs extend rising, knees tucked airborne right arm lifting chain.
Rows2 and3 form EIGHT consecutive detailed in-between frames of chain morphing into that same broad conical spear: same airborne body pose holding right hand above head with chain stretching right; links straighten, become glowing cyan, links progressively merge from hilt to tip into a blue spear silhouette, silver conical plates grow around silhouette, blue pulses fade revealing complete conical silver spear. Clear gradual transformation, not eight unrelated weapons. Row2 col1 chain still all links, row3 col4 fully formed silver conical spear. Match the weapon from reference.
Row4 four consecutive rightward throw poses: aim coiled, elbow extending, release, followthrough empty hand. Smooth frame-to-frame consistent character identity and scale. Crisp pixels and strong readable silhouettes for a JRPG.
focus: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite atlas, transparent background, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows equal cells, canvas landscape 1536x768. References: first image male Chuheun identity and pixel style; second image female Yeonwoo identity and pixel style. Create dedicated concentration/energy-gathering animation. Top row FOUR frames of Chuheun. Bottom row FOUR frames of Yeonwoo. Each frame full body standing firmly on ground facing right 3/4, same height, feet at bottom of cell, center consistent. Frame1 hands beginning to come together at abdomen eyes focused, frame2 palms cupped in front of abdomen eyes CLOSED breathing in, frame3 hands close with small blue energy aura rising up body and glowing at palms, frame4 calm focus hands lower aura settles. No yawning, no hand near mouth, no stretching, no raised-overhead arms. Subtle breathing, planted feet, small differences for smooth animation. Preserve black martial uniform blue trim white collar gray sash; male short messy black hair, female waist-length straight black hair and blunt bangs. No weapons. Generous transparent margins every cell. All cells same character scale. No text/grid/background. Crisp pixel clusters matching reference, not chibi.
assassin:
Use case stylized-concept. Transparent pixel art game sprite sheet for Kim Yeonwoo from attached character reference, same long straight black hair and bangs, black martial uniform white collar blue edging gray sash, slim tall proportions, sharp detailed pixel art. EXACT 4 columns x4 rows uniform cells with generous padding, full body each, facing right. Consistent body scale and feet baseline in each cell. No text grid or background.
16 frames row major:
row1 four progressive weapon morph poses: standing holding dangling steel chain at waist, chain glows cyan and gathers, links merge into short blade, complete silver dagger in right hand.
row2 four fast step action poses: low poised dagger crouch, leaning forward dash with hair trailing, dash stretched forward with subtle cyan streak, returning upright planted stance dagger down.
row3 four yawn poses after return: relaxed hand rising, hand covering mouth eyes shut, sleepy full yawn hand covering mouth, hand lowers.
row4 four embarrassment poses: face blushing looking down shoulders tucked, toe nudges ground with small leg bend, foot gently kicks forward looking ashamed cheeks red, foot settles with head bowed and blush. Comedic but not chibi. Preserve identity and hairstyle exactly. Crisp game sprites, no floor shadows, all separated in their cells.
eyes: Use case stylized-concept. Generate a dramatic pixel art battle eye cut-in for Kim Yeonwoo, female with long straight black hair and bangs in reference. Extreme closeup BOTH intense dark eyes and eyebrows, bangs sweeping over forehead. A single long diagonal jagged slash shaped band, face visible only within this strip, bold black and white angular ink edges and electric cyan-blue accent slashes. The band tilts upward toward right. Outside strip genuinely transparent. Wide landscape 3:1 composition. Eyes large readable, expression cold focused assassin, no smile, no text, no weapons, no full body. Detailed crisp pixel art consistent with reference character, NOT soft painted gradients. Game overlay to swipe across a 768px wide battlefield.
